verdict.rationale: xAI publishes a documented REST API (docs.x.ai) with release notes, a verified public OpenAPI spec (grok-probe-3), and llms.txt discoverability (grok-probe-1), confirming a real, machine-consumable public API surface. Community comments (grok-comm-6) note weaker agentic tool-calling reliability, but the API itself is real and documented. missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of full API parity with docs, and stronger evidence of robust agentic tool-calling performance in practice.
